title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
廣西鄉試錄序
萬曆丙子秋八月天下復大
比士于鄉惟
今天子稟首出之資接萬年之統
聖學日新
皇猷遐鬯稽古禮文之事靡不脩
飭邇者
punctuated:
廣西鄉試錄序
萬曆丙子秋八月，天下復大比士于鄉。惟今天子稟首出之資，接萬年之統，聖學日新，皇猷遐鬯，稽古禮文之事，靡不脩飭。邇者
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Guangxi Provincial Examination

In the eighth month of autumn of the bingzi year of the Wanli era [1576], the empire once again conducted the great triennial examination of scholars in the provinces. Now, the reigning Son of Heaven, endowed with preeminent natural gifts, has succeeded to the myriad-year line of imperial succession; his sagely learning is daily renewed, his august plans spread far and wide, and in investigating antiquity and ordering ritual and culture, there is nothing that has not been put in proper order. Recently, …

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
帝王之盛節也會有司貢士適當
其期
首善之化自
畿甸暨于海宇秀艾烝烝驩欣
鼓舞咸切利見之思維廣以
西則巡按監察御史陸萬鍾
祗
===
命監臨奉
至尊休德百度益以庀毖總督兩
廣軍務兵部左侍郎兼右僉
都御史凌雲翼節鉞載臨肅
清嶺海巡撫廣西都察院右
副都御史吳文華綏服貞敎
興起譽髦之達等以前巡按
punctuated: 帝王之盛節也。會有司貢士，適當其期。首善之化，自畿甸暨于海宇，秀艾烝烝，驩欣鼓舞，咸切利見之思。維廣以西，則巡按監察御史陸萬鍾祗命監臨，奉至尊休德，百度益以庀毖。總督兩廣軍務、兵部左侍郎兼右僉都御史凌雲翼，節鉞載臨，肅清嶺海；巡撫廣西、都察院右副都御史吳文華，綏服貞敎，興起譽髦。之達等以前巡按
translation_en: … the magnificent observance of sovereign kings. It happened that the relevant authorities' presentation of tribute scholars fell precisely at this appointed time. As the transformation radiating from the imperial capital extended from the metropolitan domain to the lands within the four seas, the flourishing scholars and worthy elders were all filled with joy and inspiration, earnestly longing for the auspicious audience with the great man. In the region west of Guangdong [Guangxi], the Regional Inspector and Investigating Censor Lu Wanzhong 陸萬鍾 reverently received the imperial command to serve as Supervising Official; upholding the August One's splendid virtue, he prepared and attended to all measures with ever greater care and caution. The Supreme Commander of Military Affairs of Guangdong and Guangxi, Left Vice Minister of War, and concurrent Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief Ling Yunyi 凌雲翼 arrived bearing the insignia of command to pacify and cleanse the mountains and seas of the south; the Grand Coordinator of Guangxi and Right Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate Wu Wenhua 吳文華 pacified the region and upheld upright instruction, rousing and encouraging eminent talents. I, [Zhi]da 之達, and my colleagues had been invited by the former Regional Inspector…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
御史李采菲聘至則之達及
敎諭朱信亮爲考試敎諭梁
肇脩單文盛許渙王寵麟劉
莘同考試左布政使高察右
叅政朱奎司提調按察使吳
椿副使彭文質司監試諸執
事咸遴選以充旣鎖闈合提
===
學副使高則益所束士一千
五百有奇三試之遵
制額拔五十五人爲錄以
獻之達謹稽首而序曰之達文
質無所底濫職文學甞稽載
籍觀成周選士之制考德藝
興賢能賓禮隆重所藉以隸
punctuated: 御史李采菲聘至，則之達及敎諭朱信亮爲考試，敎諭梁肇脩、單文盛、許渙、王寵麟、劉莘同考試，左布政使高察、右叅政朱奎司提調，按察使吳椿、副使彭文質司監試，諸執事咸遴選以充。旣鎖闈，合提學副使高則益所束士一千五百有奇，三試之，遵制額拔五十五人，爲錄以獻。之達謹稽首而序曰：之達文質無所底，濫職文學，甞稽載籍，觀成周選士之制，考德藝，興賢能，賓禮隆重，所藉以隸
translation_en: … [Regional Inspecting] Censor Li Caifei 李采菲, arrived by invitation, whereupon [I,] Zhida, and Instructor Zhu Xinliang 朱信亮 served as Examiners; Instructors Liang Zhaoxiu 梁肇脩, Shan Wensheng 單文盛, Xu Huan 許渙, Wang Chonglin 王寵麟, and Liu Shen 劉莘 served as Associate Examiners; Left Administration Commissioner Gao Cha 高察 and Right Administration Vice Commissioner Zhu Kui 朱奎 were in charge as Proctors; Surveillance Commissioner Wu Chun 吳椿 and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Peng Wenzhi 彭文質 were in charge as Monitoring Officials; and all the functionaries were carefully selected to fill their posts. Once the examination compound was locked, we gathered the more than one thousand five hundred scholars selected by Surveillance Vice Commissioner cum Education Intendant Gao Zeyi 高則益, tested them in three sessions, and, in compliance with the quota set by imperial decree, selected fifty-five men and compiled this record for presentation to the throne. I, Zhida, respectfully bow my head to the ground and write in preface: I, Zhida, have achieved nothing of consequence in either literary refinement or solid substance, yet I unworthily hold a literary and educational post. I have examined historical records and observed the system of selecting scholars in the flourishing Zhou dynasty, which evaluated virtue and arts, promoted the worthy and capable, and treated them as honored guests with grand ceremony, whereby that which was relied upon to attach [or: serve]…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
社稷庇蒸黎者甚厚
明興紹天闡繹偃武陳常呱隆
周之大寧監賓士之遺意著
之令甲網羅儁髦雖遐荒疏
俗黌塾棊置文治焥然勃興
垂二百餘禩士由此塗著勛
名于春秋者與成周埒顧科
===
目之制取士以文始未嘗不
樸茂後稍浸淫也之達竊莊
誦
高皇之訓有曰明道理通世物無
事華藻於乎美哉始基之矣其
時士敦本質辭不偭于法度
而致用皆效實故足術也弘
punctuated: 社稷、庇蒸黎者甚厚。明興，紹天闡繹，偃武陳常，呱隆周之大寧，監賓士之遺意，著之令甲，網羅儁髦。雖遐荒疏俗，黌塾棊置，文治焥然勃興，垂二百餘禩，士由此塗著勛名于春秋者，與成周埒。顧科目之制，取士以文，始未嘗不樸茂，後稍浸淫也。之達竊莊誦高皇之訓，有曰：「明道理，通世物，無事華藻。」於乎美哉！始基之矣。其時士敦本質，辭不偭于法度，而致用皆效實，故足術也。弘
translation_en: … bolster the altars of state and shelter the multitude of common people was profound indeed. When the Ming arose, it succeeded to Heaven's mandate and unfolded its great design, laying down arms and setting forth the constant norms. Emulating [?] the grand tranquility of the flourishing Zhou, and taking as its model the inherited intent of treating worthy scholars as honored guests, it codified this into the foremost statutes so as to gather in outstanding talents. Even in distant borderlands of untutored customs, schools have been arrayed like pieces on a game board, and civil governance has blazed forth in vigorous flourishing. For over two hundred years, the scholars who by this path have inscribed their meritorious names in the annals have rivaled those of the flourishing Zhou. Yet under the system of examination categories, in selecting scholars through literary composition, at the outset the style was unfailingly plain and substantial, whereas later it gradually grew extravagant. I, Zhida, have in private respectfully recited the instructions of the Exalted Emperor [Gao Huang, i.e., Emperor Taizu], which state: "Illuminate moral principles and understand worldly affairs [?], without indulging in flowery ornament." Oh, how admirable! Thus was the foundation first laid. At that time, scholars prized essential substance, their words did not turn their backs on standard rules, and in practical application they all achieved real results; therefore, their example is worthy of being followed. Before the Hong[zhi] …

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
治而前此道未沫裔玆以降
靡麗之漸人乆矣迺今
主上德懋淵懿秉恭儉以先天下
二三碩輔相與矢精白而斡
旋之一時經生學子頓剗華
琱還師古始已駸駸乎
國初之舊焉矧又
===
勸學興禮以風之哉廣右介居
西南垂山川盤鬱毓為人文
多鴻龐敦固之士其擢制科
登膴仕鏗鉤霱煜為世所稱
頌者繹繹相望始之達遵岳
麓而西也涉洮湘靈渠陟降
于堯山桂嶺之閒而盱衡于
punctuated:
治而前，此道未沫。裔玆以降，靡麗之漸人乆矣。迺今主上德懋淵懿，秉恭儉以先天下；二三碩輔相與矢精白而斡旋之。一時經生學子，頓剗華琱，還師古始，已駸駸乎國初之舊焉。矧又勸學興禮以風之哉！
廣右介居西南垂，山川盤鬱，毓為人文，多鴻龐敦固之士。其擢制科、登膴仕，鏗鉤霱煜，為世所稱頌者，繹繹相望。始之達遵岳麓而西也，涉洮、湘、靈渠，陟降于堯山、桂嶺之閒，而盱衡于
translation_en:
… the Hongzhi era (1488–1505) and before, this Way had not yet faded. From that time onward, ornate and decadent styles have gradually steeped into people for a long time. Yet now His Majesty, whose virtue is great, profound, and admirable, upholds reverence and frugality to lead the empire, while two or three eminent grandees together pledge pure fidelity to turn the tide. All at once, classical scholars and students have suddenly pared away flowery carving and returned to taking antiquity as their teacher, already galloping back toward the old ways of the founding of the dynasty. How much more so when learning is encouraged and rites are promoted to transform them by example!

Guangxi lies on the southwestern frontier; its mountains and rivers wind and gather in luxuriant density, nurturing human culture and producing many scholars of grand simplicity and steadfast solidity. Those who have been selected through the civil service examinations and ascended to high office—resounding like bells and shining like auspicious clouds, praised and celebrated by the world—have followed one after another in an unbroken succession. When I, Zhida, first traveled west along Mount Yuelu, crossing the Tao and Xiang rivers and the Ling Canal, ascending and descending between Mount Yao and the Guiling ranges, and surveying…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
黨巷則見物力侵而土風儉
寠無芬華綺麗之觀既入簾
縱閱諸士所爲文類皆含英
茹荄惣微說約不驚精于棘
猴雕龍而闡晰經術敷暾今
古悉中肯綮自非涵泳
主德靡然顧化何能及此以故〔之〕
===
〔達〕等于諸士亟收之誠欲得
眞才以裨實用非徒貴其華
也昔孔子侍于魯君君賜之
桃與黍黍以雪桃也乃孔子
則先飯黍而後啗桃蓋黍者
五穀之長祭爲上盛桃雖華
而悅人其實不登于廟先後
punctuated: 黨巷，則見物力侵而土風儉寠，無芬華綺麗之觀。既入簾，縱閱諸士所爲文，類皆含英茹荄，惣微說約，不驚精于棘猴雕龍，而闡晰經術、敷暾今古，悉中肯綮。自非涵泳主德，靡然顧化，何能及此？以故〔之達〕等于諸士亟收之，誠欲得眞才以裨實用，非徒貴其華也。昔孔子侍于魯君，君賜之桃與黍，黍以雪桃也，乃孔子則先飯黍而後啗桃。蓋黍者，五穀之長，祭爲上盛；桃雖華而悅人，其實不登于廟。先後
translation_en: … the village lanes, I saw that material resources were depleted and local customs were frugal and poor, lacking any sights of luxuriant splendor or ornate beauty. Once I entered behind the examination screen and broadly reviewed the essays composed by the scholars, they generally all cherished the finest essence and absorbed the fundamental roots, summarizing subtleties and expounding the essentials. They did not exhaust their spirits on carving monkeys out of thorns or embellishing dragons, yet in elucidating classical scholarship and clearly setting forth matters past and present, they all hit the crucial points. Were it not that they are steeped in the Sovereign's virtue and sweepingly look toward his transforming influence, how could they reach this level? For this reason, I, [Zhida], and my colleagues eagerly selected these scholars, truly desiring to obtain genuine talent to aid practical use, rather than merely valuing their superficial華 [flourishes]. In antiquity, when Confucius attended upon the ruler of Lu, the ruler bestowed upon him a peach and glutinous millet—the millet being intended to wipe clean the peach. Yet Confucius ate the millet first and only afterward ate the peach. For millet is the chief of the five grains, used as the highest offering in sacrifices; whereas the peach, though showy and pleasing to people, has fruit that is not presented in the ancestral temple. The priority given to first and last …

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
殊用貴賤之義也樹人者毋
抑是類乎故士之工言而不
中于仁不如訥之愿也縟儀
而不協于禮不如野之朴也
勇往而不準于經不如退之
讓也炫明而不適于用不如
晦之藏也今諸士惇本實邁
===
昌明應
右文之盛際袪觩骩之陋習第
藉令奉其所有一比之于道
出而副有司之求猶之嘉穀
秀實升豆籩而薦清廟行必
資之矣是在諸士知所自樹
而主司者不藉有樹人之慶
punctuated: 殊用，貴賤之義也。樹人者毋抑是類乎？故士之工言而不中于仁，不如訥之愿也；縟儀而不協于禮，不如野之朴也；勇往而不準于經，不如退之讓也；炫明而不適于用，不如晦之藏也。今諸士惇本實、邁昌明，應右文之盛際，袪觩骩之陋習。第藉令奉其所有，一比之于道，出而副有司之求，猶之嘉穀秀實，升豆籩而薦清廟，行必資之矣。是在諸士知所自樹，而主司者不藉有樹人之慶…
translation_en: …differing in precedence and use—this is the meaning of what is noble and what is base. Are those who cultivate men not also bound by this principle? Therefore, for a scholar to be skillful in speech yet fail to hit the mark of benevolence is not as good as the sincerity of being slow to speak; to be elaborate in ceremony yet fail to accord with ritual propriety is not as good as the simplicity of rusticity; to advance boldly yet fail to conform to the constant standard is not as good as the deference of retiring; to flaunt brilliance yet fail to be suited for practical use is not as good as the reserve of remaining obscure. Now you scholars esteem what is fundamental and substantial, encounter an era of flourishing enlightenment, respond to a glorious age that venerates culture, and cast off the vulgar habits of superficial and crooked artifice [? 觩骩]. If only you present what you possess, measure it entirely against the Way, and go forth to fulfill the expectations of the authorities, it will be just like fine grain coming into ear and bearing fruit, raised up in sacrificial vessels of wood and bamboo to be offered in the Pure Temple—in practice, reliance will surely be placed upon you. This rests upon you scholars knowing how to establish yourselves; and will the chief examiners not thereby share in the joy of having cultivated men…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
哉是舉也清戎監察御史李
頤肅憲維風總兵官征蠻將
軍署都督同知李錫詰戎鎮
遠右布政使李鳳右叅政管
副使事沈子木副使吳善徐
作左叅議秦舜翰右叅議陳
應春僉事李一迪王一卿皆
===
脩秩于外叅將王瑞倪中化
亦孔昭王德懋署都指揮僉
事夏尚忠黃允中皆防範于
外按察使仍管叅政事吳一
介副使顧章志以入
賀行左叅議劉應峯以遷秩行
皆與襄始事刑部署員外郎
punctuated: 哉？是舉也，清戎監察御史李頤肅憲維風；總兵官、征蠻將軍、署都督同知李錫詰戎鎮遠；右布政使李鳳，右叅政管副使事沈子木，副使吳善、徐作，左叅議秦舜翰，右叅議陳應春，僉事李一迪、王一卿，皆脩秩于外；叅將王瑞、倪中化、亦孔昭、王德懋，署都指揮僉事夏尚忠、黃允中，皆防範于外；按察使仍管叅政事吳一介，副使顧章志以入賀行，左叅議劉應峯以遷秩行，皆與襄始事；刑部署員外郎
translation_en: … indeed? In this undertaking, Troop-Purifying Investigating Censor (qingrong jiancha yushi) Li Yi 李頤 upheld the law and maintained the moral tone; Regional Commander (zongbing guan), General for Subjugating the Man-Barbarians (zhengman jiangjun), and Acting Vice Commissioner-in-Chief (shu dudu tongzhi) Li Xi 李錫 kept the military in order and pacified the distant frontiers; Right Administration Commissioner (you buzheng shi) Li Feng 李鳳, Right Administration Vice Commissioner (you canzheng) administering the affairs of a Surveillance Vice Commissioner (fushi) Shen Zimu 沈子木, Surveillance Vice Commissioners Wu Shan 吳善 and Xu Zuo 徐作, Left Assistant Administration Commissioner (zuo canyi) Qin Shunhan 秦舜翰, Right Assistant Administration Commissioner Chen Yingchun 陳應春, and Assistant Surveillance Commissioners (qianshi) Li Yidi 李一迪 and Wang Yiqing 王一卿 all attended to their official duties outside the examination compound; Assistant Regional Commanders (canjiang) Wang Rui 王瑞, Ni Zhonghua 倪中化, Yi Kongzhao 亦孔昭, and Wang Demao 王德懋, and Acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioners (shu du zhihui qianshi) Xia Shangzhong 夏尚忠 and Huang Yunzhong 黃允中 all maintained security and precautions on the outside; Surveillance Commissioner (ancha shi) continuing to administer the affairs of an Administration Vice Commissioner Wu Yijie 吳一介 and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Gu Zhangzhi 顧章志, who departed to present congratulations at court, and Left Assistant Administration Commissioner Liu Yingfeng 劉應峯, who departed upon promotion to another post, all participated in assisting at the beginning of the affair; and Acting Vice Director (shu yuanwailang) in the Ministry of Justice (xingbu)…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
朱湘以讞獄至則遹觀厥成
者也法得竝書
福建興化府儒學教授李之
達謹序
punctuated:
朱湘以讞獄至，則遹觀厥成者也，法得竝書。
福建興化府儒學教授李之達謹序。
translation_en:
… Zhu Xiang 朱湘, who arrived to adjudicate criminal cases, witnessed its completion; by rule, all of their names are recorded together here.
Respectfully prefaced by Li Zhida 李之達, Instructor in the Confucian School of Xinghua Prefecture, Fujian.

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
萬曆四年廣西鄉試
監臨官
巡按廣西監察御史陸萬鍾〔元量直隸華亭縣人乙丑進士〕
提調官
廣西等處承宣布政使司右布政使高察〔汝哲四川內江縣人丙辰進士〕
廣西等處承宣布政使司右參政朱奎〔季文江西南昌縣人巳未進士〕
監試官
廣西等處提刑按察司按察使吳椿〔壽卿江西新建縣人巳未進士〕
廣西等處提刑按察司副使彭文質〔在份福建莆田縣人巳未進士〕
===
考試官
福建興化府儒學教授李之達〔積之江西東鄉縣人丁卯貢士〕
浙江紹興府上虞縣儒學教諭朱信亮〔廷寅江西南昌縣人乙卯貢士〕
同考試官
直隸常州府無錫縣儒學教諭梁肇脩〔幼希廣東順德縣人辛酉貢士〕
浙江湖州府長興縣儒學教諭單文盛〔質甫江西臨川縣人戊午貢士〕
江西九江府德安縣儒學教諭許渙〔希文江西南城縣人壬子貢士〕
江西吉安府萬安縣儒學教諭王寵麟〔世禎湖廣麻城縣人庚午貢士〕
江西饒州府鄱陽縣儒學教諭劉萃〔子升湖廣江陵縣人庚午貢士〕
punctuated:
萬曆四年廣西鄉試

監臨官：
巡按廣西監察御史陸萬鍾〔元量，直隸華亭縣人，乙丑進士〕。

提調官：
廣西等處承宣布政使司右布政使高察〔汝哲，四川內江縣人，丙辰進士〕；
廣西等處承宣布政使司右參政朱奎〔季文，江西南昌縣人，巳未進士〕。

監試官：
廣西等處提刑按察司按察使吳椿〔壽卿，江西新建縣人，巳未進士〕；
廣西等處提刑按察司副使彭文質〔在份，福建莆田縣人，巳未進士〕。

考試官：
福建興化府儒學教授李之達〔積之，江西東鄉縣人，丁卯貢士〕；
浙江紹興府上虞縣儒學教諭朱信亮〔廷寅，江西南昌縣人，乙卯貢士〕。

同考試官：
直隸常州府無錫縣儒學教諭梁肇脩〔幼希，廣東順德縣人，辛酉貢士〕；
浙江湖州府長興縣儒學教諭單文盛〔質甫，江西臨川縣人，戊午貢士〕；
江西九江府德安縣儒學教諭許渙〔希文，江西南城縣人，壬子貢士〕；
江西吉安府萬安縣儒學教諭王寵麟〔世禎，湖廣麻城縣人，庚午貢士〕；
江西饒州府鄱陽縣儒學教諭劉萃〔子升，湖廣江陵縣人，庚午貢士〕。

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
印卷官

收掌試卷官

南寧府知府杜思〔子睿浙江鄞縣人丙辰進士〕
受卷官
平樂府知府羅黃裳〔美至廣東高明縣人己未進士〕
潯州府知府戴濂〔希茂浙江麗水縣人壬戌進士〕
===

思恩軍民府知府侯國治〔平裕廣東南海縣人甲午貢士〕
慶遠府同知蕭騰鳳〔明仲福建晉江縣人戊辰進士〕
彌封官
桂林府同知梁直〔養浩廣東東莞縣人乙卯貢士〕
桂林府推官孫承南〔可遂江西清江縣人丁卯貢士〕
桂林府永寧州知州鄭應齡〔君亮福建莆田縣人戊午貢士〕
南寧府新寧州知州趙宗鳳〔德夫福建龍溪縣人甲子貢士〕
桂林府臨桂縣知縣王懋中〔惟一江西南城縣人甲戌進士〕
punctuated:

廣西等處提刑按察司經歷司經歷石維端〔民肅，福建福清縣人，吏員〕。

平樂府知府羅黃裳〔美至，廣東高明縣人，己未進士〕。
潯州府知府戴濂〔希茂，浙江麗水縣人，壬戌進士〕。

彌封官：

Examination Paper Stamping Officials (印卷官):
Zou Mu 鄒穆 (courtesy name Junyuan 均遠, a native of Yichun County 宜春縣, Jiangxi, and a Subofficial Functionary [吏員]), Registrar in the Registry of the Guangxi Provincial Administration Commission.

Zheng Yingling 鄭應齡 (courtesy name Junliang 君亮, a native of Putian County 莆田縣, Fujian, and a tribute student / provincial graduate [gongshi 貢士] of the wuwu year [1558]), Department Magistrate of Yongning Department 永寧州 in Guilin Prefecture 桂林府.
Zhao Zongfeng 趙宗鳳 (courtesy name Defu 德夫, a native of Longxi County 龍溪縣, Fujian, and a tribute student / provincial graduate [gongshi 貢士] of the jiazi year [1564]), Department Magistrate of Xinning Department 新寧州 in Nanning Prefecture 南寧府.
Wang Maozhong 王懋中 (courtesy name Weiyi 惟一, a native of Nancheng County 南城縣, Jiangxi, and a metropolitan graduate [jinshi] of the jiaxu year [1574]), District Magistrate of Lingui County 臨桂縣 in Guilin Prefecture 桂林府.

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
夫子聖者與何其多能也子貢曰固天縱
之將聖又多能也子聞之曰大宰知我
乎吾少也賤故多能鄙事君子多乎哉
不多也
郊社之禮所以事上帝也
聖人人倫之至也欲爲君盡君道欲爲臣
盡臣道二者皆法堯舜而已矣
===
易
大有柔得尊位大中而上下應之曰大有
其德剛健而文明應乎天而時行是以
元亨
九二貞吉象曰九二貞吉以中也
夫乾其靜也專其動也直是以大生焉夫
坤其靜也翕其動也闢是以廣生焉廣
大配天地
臨觀之義或與或求
punctuated:
第壹場
四書
「夫子聖者與？何其多能也？」子貢曰：「固天縱之將聖，又多能也。」子聞之曰：「大宰知我乎！吾少也賤，故多能鄙事。君子多乎哉？不多也。」
郊社之禮，所以事上帝也。
聖人，人倫之至也。欲爲君，盡君道；欲爲臣，盡臣道。二者皆法堯、舜而已矣。

易
《大有》，柔得尊位大中，而上下應之，曰《大有》。其德剛健而文明，應乎天而時行，是以元亨。
九二，貞吉。《象》曰：「九二貞吉」，以中也。
夫乾，其靜也專，其動也直，是以大生焉。夫坤，其靜也翕，其動也闢，是以廣生焉。廣大配天地。
《臨》、《觀》之義，或與或求。
translation_en:
First Session

The Four Books

"[The Great Officer asked,] 'Is the Master a sage? How is it that he has so many abilities?' Zigong 子貢 said, 'Certainly Heaven has endowed him so abundantly that he is a sage, and furthermore he has many abilities.' When the Master heard of it, he said, 'Does the Great Officer know me? When I was young, my station was humble, and therefore I acquired many abilities in menial matters. Does the gentleman need so many abilities? No, he does not need many.'" (Analects, 9.6)

"The ceremonies of the sacrifices to Heaven and Earth are those by which one serves the Lord on High." (Doctrine of the Mean, 19)

"The sage is the culmination of human relationships. One who wishes to be a ruler fulfills the way of a ruler; one who wishes to be a minister fulfills the way of a minister. Both simply take Yao 堯 and Shun 舜 as their model, and nothing more." (Mencius, 4A.2)

Book of Changes (Yi 易)

"Possession in Great Measure (Dayou 大有): The yielding line attains the honored position in the great center, and the lines above and below respond to it; hence it is called Possession in Great Measure. Its virtue is strong and vigorous yet civilized and bright; it responds to Heaven and acts in accordance with the time, and therefore there is supreme success." (Hexagram 14, Dayou, Commentary on the Decision)

"Nine in the second place: Perseverance brings good fortune. The Commentary on the Images (Xiang 象) says: 'Nine in the second place: Perseverance brings good fortune'—because it holds the central position." (Hexagram 9, Xiaoxu 小畜, or Hexagram 38, Kui 睽, or Hexagram 40, Xie 解, or Hexagram 53, Jian 漸, or Hexagram 57, Xun 巽)

"As for the Creative (Qian 乾), in its stillness it is專 (concentrated/unified), and in its movement it is straight; therefore it produces the great. As for the Receptive (Kun 坤), in its stillness it closes together, and in its movement it opens wide; therefore it produces the vast. In vastness and greatness, they match Heaven and Earth." (Appended Remarks, Part I, Chapter 6)

"The meaning of Approach (Lin 臨) and Contemplation (Guan 觀) is that in some cases they give, and in some cases they seek." (Miscellaneous Notes on the Hexagrams, Заgua 雜卦)

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
書
文命敷于四海祗承于帝曰后克艱厥后
臣克艱厥臣政乃乂黎民敏德
終始愼厥與惟明明后
其爾典常作之師
一人有慶兆民賴之其寧惟永
詩
羔羊之皮素絲五紽退食自公委蛇委蛇
禾易長畝終善且有曾孫不怒農夫克敏
===
曾孫之稼如茨如梁曾孫之庾如坻如
京乃求千斯倉乃求萬斯箱黍稷稻粱
農夫之慶
之綱之紀燕及朋友百辟卿士媚于天子
不解于位民之攸墍
紹庭上下陟降厥家
春秋
晉人敗狄于箕僖公三十有三年十有二
月乙丑季孫行父及晉卻犖盟于扈成
punctuated:
《書》
「文命敷于四海，祗承于帝。曰：后克艱厥后，臣克艱厥臣，政乃乂，黎民敏德。」
「終始愼厥與，惟明明后。」
「其爾典常作之師。」
「一人有慶，兆民賴之，其寧惟永。」
《詩》
「羔羊之皮，素絲五紽。退食自公，委蛇委蛇。」
「禾易長畝，終善且有。曾孫不怒，農夫克敏。曾孫之稼，如茨如梁；曾孫之庾，如坻如京。乃求千斯倉，乃求萬斯箱。黍稷稻粱，農夫之慶。」
「之綱之紀，燕及朋友。百辟卿士，媚于天子。不解于位，民之攸墍。」
「紹庭上下，陟降厥家。」
《春秋》
「晉人敗狄于箕。」僖公三十有三年。「十有二月乙丑，季孫行父及晉卻犖盟于扈。」成…
translation_en:
Classic of Documents (Shu):
"His civilizing teachings were spread throughout the four seas, and he reverently received from the Sovereign, saying: 'If the ruler can appreciate the difficulty of being a ruler, and the minister can appreciate the difficulty of being a minister, government will be well-ordered, and the black-haired people will be quick to cultivate virtue.'"
"From beginning to end carefully choosing those with whom one associates—such is a truly enlightened ruler."
"Take your constant statutes as your teacher."
"When the One Man has goodness, the millions of people rely on him, and their peace is everlasting."

Classic of Odes (Shi):
"Lambskins and sheep's pelts, with five braids of white silk. Retiring from public duty to take their meal, how easy and self-possessed they are!"
"The grain is well-cultivated all along the long acres; in the end it is good and abundant. The descendant does not show anger; the husbandmen are diligent. The descendant's standing grain is thick as thatch and high as a bridge; the descendant's open stacks are like islands and high mounds. He shall seek a thousand granaries; he shall seek ten thousand carts. Millet, panicled millet, rice, and sorghum—the joy of the husbandmen!"
"Giving law and order to all, bringing peace and joy to friends. All the feudal lords and court ministers bear loving devotion to the Son of Heaven; never remiss in their positions, through them the people find rest."
"Continuing to move up and down in the court, ascending and descending in his house."

Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu):

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
公十有六年
宋人齊人楚人盟于鹿上僖公二十有一
年
三月公會齊侯宋公陳侯衛侯鄭伯許男
曹伯盟于牡丘遂次于匡公孫敖
帥師及諸侯之大夫救徐僖公十有五
年六月公會單子晉侯宋公衛侯鄭伯
莒子邾子齊世子光巳未同盟于雞澤
陳侯使袁僑如會戊寅叔孫豹及
===
諸侯之大夫及陳袁僑盟襄公三年
八月晉荀吳帥師滅陸渾之戎昭公十有
七年
禮記
天子乃命將帥選士厲兵簡練桀俊專任
有功以征不義詰誅暴慢以明好惡順
彼遠方
故自郊社祖廟山川五祀義之脩而禮之
藏也
punctuated:
公十有六年。
宋人、齊人、楚人盟于鹿上。僖公二十有一年。
三月，公會齊侯、宋公、陳侯、衛侯、鄭伯、許男、曹伯盟于牡丘，遂次于匡。公孫敖帥師及諸侯之大夫救徐。僖公十有五年。六月，公會單子、晉侯、宋公、衛侯、鄭伯、莒子、邾子、齊世子光，巳未，同盟于雞澤。陳侯使袁僑如會。戊寅，叔孫豹及諸侯之大夫及陳袁僑盟。襄公三年。
八月，晉荀吳帥師滅陸渾之戎。昭公十有七年。

禮記
天子乃命將帥，選士厲兵，簡練桀俊，專任有功，以征不義，詰誅暴慢，以明好惡，順彼遠方。
故自郊社、祖廟、山川、五祀，義之脩而禮之藏也。
translation_en:
…Sixteenth year of Duke [Cheng].
Men of Song, men of Qi, and men of Chu made a covenant at Lushang (Twenty-first year of Duke Xi).
In the third month, the Duke met the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Chen, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Baron of Xu, and the Earl of Cao to make a covenant at Muqiu, and thereupon halted at Kuang; Gongsun Ao led a force and, together with the Great Officers of the feudal lords, went to the rescue of Xu (Fifteenth year of Duke Xi). In the sixth month, the Duke met the Viscount of Shan, the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, and Guang, Heir Apparent of Qi; on the jiwei day, they made a common covenant at Jize; the Marquis of Chen sent Yuan Qiao to attend the meeting; on the wuyin day, Shusun Bao, together with the Great Officers of the feudal lords, made a covenant with Yuan Qiao of Chen (Third year of Duke Xiang).
In the eighth month, Xun Wu of Jin led a force and extinguished the Rong of Luhun (Seventeenth year of Duke Zhao).

Book of Rites (Liji):
"The Son of Heaven then commands his generals and commanders to select warriors and sharpen weapons, to choose and train men of outstanding talent, and to give exclusive responsibility to the meritorious, so as to campaign against the unrighteous, and to call to account and punish the violent and insolent, thereby making clear what he likes and dislikes, and bringing submission from those distant regions."
"Therefore, from the suburban sacrifices and the altar of the soil and grain, the ancestral temple, the mountains and rivers, to the five household sacrifices, these are the cultivation of righteousness and the repository of ritual."

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
樂者敦和率神而從天禮者別宜居鬼而
從地故聖人作樂以應天制禮以配地
禮樂明備天地官矣
臣下竭力盡能以立功於國君必報之以
爵祿故臣下皆務竭力盡能以立功是
以國安而君寧
第貳場
論
正心爲天下萬事之本
===
詔誥表內科一道
擬漢賜天下今年田租之半詔文帝二年
擬唐以李靖等爲黜陟大使分行天下誥
貞觀八年
擬輔臣疏內外文武臣工職名於屏風恭
進
御覽表萬曆二年
判語五條
官員赴任過限
punctuated:
「樂者，敦和，率神而從天；禮者，別宜，居鬼而從地。故聖人作樂以應天，制禮以配地，禮樂明備，天地官矣。」
「臣下竭力盡能以立功於國，君必報之以爵祿，故臣下皆務竭力盡能以立功，是以國安而君寧。」

第貳場
論
《正心爲天下萬事之本》
詔、誥、表內科一道
《擬漢賜天下今年田租之半詔》文帝二年
《擬唐以李靖等爲黜陟大使分行天下誥》貞觀八年
《擬輔臣疏內外文武臣工職名於屏風恭進御覽表》萬曆二年
判語五條
《官員赴任過限》
translation_en:
"Music promotes harmony, leading the spirits and following Heaven; ritual distinguishes what is appropriate, settling the ghosts and following Earth. Therefore, the sages created music to respond to Heaven and instituted ritual to match Earth. When ritual and music are clearly and fully established, Heaven and Earth perform their proper functions."
"When ministers and subordinates exhaust their strength and abilities to establish merit in the state, the ruler must reward them with noble ranks and emoluments; thus ministers and subordinates all strive to exhaust their strength and abilities to establish merit, and thereby the state is secure and the ruler is at peace."

"Rectifying the Mind Is the Foundation of the Myriad Affairs of the World"

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
丁夫差遣不平
禁止師巫邪術
邊境申索軍需
失時不脩隄防
第叄場
策〔五道〕
問帝王之興中天地為綱常主繫於民彝
世教至重也是故治莫先於明倫倫莫
大於君親古今言忠孝者至虞舜周公
===
極矣載在傳記鑿鑿可攷孝經一書說
者以為成於曾子門人之手明順教孝
為世所宗迨漢有擬作忠經十八篇者
篇中意旨又若不專為人臣訓不知與
孝經可相表裏否洪惟
太祖高皇帝開天立極人紀肇脩貽謨垂範至
宏且遠
成祖文皇帝闡烈綏猷製為
聖學心法一書其於臣道子道蓋縷縷言之
punctuated:
丁夫差遣不平；
禁止師巫邪術；
邊境申索軍需；
失時不脩隄防。

第叄場
策〔五道〕

問：帝王之興，中天地為綱常主，繫於民彝世教至重也。是故治莫先於明倫，倫莫大於君親。古今言忠孝者，至虞舜、周公極矣，載在傳記，鑿鑿可攷。《孝經》一書，說者以為成於曾子門人之手，明順教孝，為世所宗。迨漢有擬作《忠經》十八篇者，篇中意旨又若不專為人臣訓，不知與《孝經》可相表裏否？洪惟太祖高皇帝開天立極，人紀肇脩，貽謨垂範，至宏且遠。成祖文皇帝闡烈綏猷，製為《聖學心法》一書，其於臣道、子道蓋縷縷言之，

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
孝順事實紀孝行甚具
宣宗章皇帝思古明良之盛
製歷代臣鑑其叙臣事甚詳又
命儒臣編輯
五倫書頒布中外即古之誕告多方訓迪百
官何以加焉二百餘年敦叙興行百司
憲度庶民歸極有繇然也
皇上稟睿纂曆諸所陳之象魏宣之渙汗者無
不討
===
累朝故實而脩明之祗若
列祖敬事
兩宮以孝治先天下二三喆輔精白承休庶幾
與重華元聖比隆矣
上益銳於理
宸翰飛灑頒賜臣工直以古良弼望諸輔佐至
部臺講讀之臣並加
寵勸所以作忠者又何惓也
明良相遇千載一時薄海內外有不躍然思奮
punctuated: 《孝順事實》紀孝行甚具。宣宗章皇帝思古明良之盛，製《歷代臣鑑》，其叙臣事甚詳；又命儒臣編輯《五倫書》，頒布中外。即古之誕告多方、訓迪百官，何以加焉？二百餘年，敦叙興行，百司憲度，庶民歸極，有繇然也。皇上稟睿纂曆，諸所陳之象魏、宣之渙汗者，無不討累朝故實而脩明之；祗若列祖，敬事兩宮，以孝治先天下。二三喆輔，精白承休，庶幾與重華、元聖比隆矣。上益銳於理，宸翰飛灑，頒賜臣工，直以古良弼望諸輔佐；至部臺、講讀之臣，並加寵勸，所以作忠者又何惓也！明良相遇，千載一時，薄海內外，有不躍然思奮
translation_en:
… the True Account of Filial Obedience (Xiaoshun shishi) records acts of filial piety in great completeness. Emperor Xuanzong Zhang [the Xuande Emperor], reflecting on the flourishing of enlightened rulers and worthy ministers in antiquity, composed the Mirror for Ministers through the Ages (Lidai chenjian), which recounts the deeds of ministers in great detail; he also ordered Confucian officials to compile the Book of the Five Relationships (Wulun shu) and promulgate it throughout the court and the provinces. Even the ancient grand announcements to the many regions and instructions to the hundred officials—how could they surpass this? For more than two hundred years, social relationships have been cultivated and virtuous conduct promoted, the hundred agencies have taken this as their model, and the common people have turned toward the supreme standard—there is indeed a reason for it.

His Majesty, endowed with sagely wisdom, has succeeded to the throne. In all that is displayed at the palace gates and proclaimed in imperial edicts, there is nothing in which he does not examine the precedents of successive reigns to renew and clarify them; reverently following the imperial ancestors and respectfully serving the Two Empresses Dowager, he leads the empire through filial governance. Two or three wise grand councilors, with pure devotion, uphold his Mandate, almost rivaling Chonghua [Emperor Shun] and the Great Sage [Yi Yin or the Duke of Zhou] in splendor. His Majesty is ever more intent upon good governance: his imperial calligraphy flows forth and is bestowed upon his officials, directly looking to the grand councilors to be like the worthy coadjutors of antiquity; extending even to the officials of the ministries and the Censorate, and the Lecturers and Readers-in-waiting, he confers upon them all favored encouragement—how earnest he is in inspiring loyalty! An enlightened ruler and worthy ministers have met—a moment that comes once in a thousand years. Within and beyond the four seas, is there anyone who does not leap with eagerness to exert…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
者乎諸生抱經待問茲移孝為忠之日
也將安所報稱哉其悉陳所蘊
問記有之帝入太學承師而問道則視學
之典所從來久矣然天子曰辟雝而又
曰成均于義何居釋奠禮也而又曰釋
菜于制何別抑可言其大較否鎬京辟
雝四方咸服炳乎莫可尚已漢而後有
詔諸生雅吹擊磬盡日乃罷者有會諸
儒執經問難正坐自講者有召博士發
===
春秋題者有詔祭酒講孝經者有命講
周易泰卦與說命三篇者有令說論語
因閱東序三禮圖者豈皆有得于承師
問道之意否歟洪惟我
皇上梃明哲之資執粹清之道
踐祚以來
儲思聽納
典學緝熙
篤禮儒賢頻開
punctuated:
者乎？諸生抱經待問，茲移孝為忠之日也，將安所報稱哉？其悉陳所蘊。
問：《記》有之：「帝入太學，承師而問道。」則視學之典，所從來久矣。然天子曰「辟雝」，而又曰「成均」，于義何居？釋奠，禮也，而又曰「釋菜」，于制何別？抑可言其大較否？鎬京辟雝，四方咸服，炳乎莫可尚已。漢而後，有詔諸生雅吹擊磬、盡日乃罷者；有會諸儒執經問難、正坐自講者；有召博士發《春秋》題者；有詔祭酒講《孝經》者；有命講《周易》〈泰〉卦與〈說命〉三篇者；有令說《論語》，因閱東序《三禮圖》者。豈皆有得于承師問道之意否歟？洪惟我皇上梃明哲之資，執粹清之道，踐祚以來，儲思聽納，典學緝熙，篤禮儒賢，頻開…
translation_en:
…would not leap up eager to rouse themselves? You students embrace the classics and await our questions; today is the day to transform filial piety into loyalty—how will you repay and match [this grace]? Set forth in full what you have stored in your minds.

Question: It is said in the Record [of Rites]: "When the Emperor entered the Imperial University, he attended upon his teachers and inquired after the Way." Thus the ritual of inspecting the Imperial University is of long-standing origin. Yet for the Son of Heaven it was called the Circular Moat (Biyong), and also called the Hall of Tuned Harmony (Chengjun)—what is the meaning behind these names? The Sacrificial Offering (shidian) is a rite, yet there is also the Offering of Vegetables (shicai)—how do they differ in institutional regulation? Can you state the general outlines of this? With the Circular Moat at the capital of Hao, the four quarters all submitted—illustrious indeed, nothing could surpass it! From the Han dynasty onward, there was one who decreed that the students play elegant wind music and strike the stone chimes, stopping only at the end of the day; there was one who assembled the Confucian scholars to hold the classics and debate difficulties while sitting upright to lecture in person; there was one who summoned the Erudites to expound topics from the Spring and Autumn Annals (Chunqiu); there was one who decreed that the Chancellor of the Directorate of Education lecture on the Classic of Filial Piety (Xiaojing); there was one who commanded lectures on the Tai hexagram of the Book of Changes (Zhouyi) and the three chapters of the "Charge to Yue" (Yue ming); and there was one who ordered an exposition of the Analects (Lunyu) and thereupon inspected the Illustrations to the Three Ritual Classics (Sanli tu) in the Eastern Wing. Did all of these truly grasp the meaning of attending upon teachers and inquiring after the Way, or not?

We reflect upon how broadly our Sovereign Emperor, endowed with sagely and discerning qualities and holding fast to the pure and clear Way, ever since ascending the throne has focused His thoughts on heeding counsel, devoted Himself to learning with continuous illumination, earnestly honored Confucian worthies, and frequently opened…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
講幄爍哉
聖德侔往初矣乃者
車駕幸太學釋奠
先師因
御彝倫堂
命儒臣進講
盛節駿聲渙揚寓內學士大夫交口而侈頌
之諸生身遊膠庠雖在萬里外亦靡不
借為色澤然
===
皇上脩問道閎摹而為臣子者不能將盛美以
効靖獻謂
今日何倘欲闡道術要眇仰裨
聖學宥密其說何繇執事者願有聞也
問王政莫大于明時授時莫先于治曆羲
氏和氏之法載在堯典其詳不得盡聞
然以閏月定四時所以成歲功也後世
增入歲差之說不知昉之者誰歟豈置
閏之外復有所謂差歟古今改曆者無
punctuated:
講幄。爍哉！聖德侔往初矣。乃者車駕幸太學，釋奠先師，因御彝倫堂，命儒臣進講。盛節駿聲，渙揚寓內，學士大夫交口而侈頌之。諸生身遊膠庠，雖在萬里外，亦靡不借為色澤。然皇上脩問道閎摹，而為臣子者不能將盛美以効靖獻，謂今日何？倘欲闡道術要眇，仰裨聖學宥密，其說何繇？執事者願有聞也。
問：王政莫大于明時，授時莫先于治曆。羲氏、和氏之法，載在《堯典》，其詳不得盡聞，然以閏月定四時，所以成歲功也。後世增入歲差之說，不知昉之者誰歟？豈置閏之外，復有所謂差歟？古今改曆者無
translation_en:
…the Classics Colloquium. Brilliant indeed! His sacred virtue equals that of the earliest antiquity. Recently, the Imperial Carriage visited the Directorate of Education to offer a sacrifice of libation to the Former Teacher, and thereupon His Majesty took His seat in the Hall of Moral Principles (Yilun Tang) and commanded the Confucian officials to advance and lecture. This grand ceremonial occasion and glorious renown have spread throughout the empire, and scholars and great officers join their voices in lavish praise of it. Although you students who study in the prefectural and county schools are ten thousand li away, there is none among you who does not share in its reflected luster. Yet if His Majesty cultivates the grand design of inquiring into the Way, and those who are His ministers and subjects cannot advance His surpassing excellence so as to offer loyal counsel, what would that say of the present day? If you wish to expound the subtle essentials of the art of the Way in order respectfully to aid the profound depths of the Sacred Learning, from what basis should your discourse proceed? The officials in charge wish to hear of it.

Question: In kingly governance, nothing is greater than clarifying the seasons; in granting the seasons, nothing comes before regulating the calendar. The methods of the Xi and He clans are recorded in the Canon of Yao (Yaodian); their details cannot be heard in full, yet using the intercalary month to fix the four seasons was the means by which the work of the year was completed. Later generations added the theory of the precession of the equinoxes (suicha); who was it that originated this? Could it be that beyond inserting intercalary months, there is also what is called a discrepancy (cha)? From antiquity to the present, those who have reformed the calendar number no…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
慮數十家自黄帝訖秦末改者凡六由
西漢訖東漢改者凡五由魏訖隋末改
者凡十三由唐訖周末改者凡十六由
宋太祖訖宋末改者凡十八由金訖元
改者凡三其詳可得陳歟就中推驗之
精後代莫能外者有三家今尚有可尋
歟夫一曆之改非偶合億中也兼綜羣
議考測圖影思無遺智法無遺術宜其
永久不變也即歷代長于曆者不數歲
===
而輒差其故何歟我
朝承運以來三曆協于五紀一統徵諸七政
堯欽舜敕不是過矣然曆雖以大統為
名而積分猶授時之數年遠數盈漸差
天度臺官建議欲隨時脩改者屢矣不
知果有定見歟占天象者不過擬諸日
月之交食耳漢魏以前日食俱在朔以
後或在晦又何歟班固作漢志明治曆
不可不擇者有三今求而應者有若人
punctuated: 慮數十家：自黄帝訖秦末，改者凡六；由西漢訖東漢，改者凡五；由魏訖隋末，改者凡十三；由唐訖周末，改者凡十六；由宋太祖訖宋末，改者凡十八；由金訖元，改者凡三。其詳可得陳歟？就中推驗之精，後代莫能外者有三家，今尚有可尋歟？夫一曆之改，非偶合億中也。兼綜羣議，考測圖影，思無遺智，法無遺術，宜其永久不變也。即歷代長于曆者，不數歲而輒差，其故何歟？我朝承運以來，三曆協于五紀，一統徵諸七政，堯欽舜敕，不是過矣。然曆雖以《大統》為名，而積分猶《授時》之數，年遠數盈，漸差天度，臺官建議欲隨時脩改者屢矣，不知果有定見歟？占天象者，不過擬諸日月之交食耳。漢魏以前，日食俱在朔，以後或在晦，又何歟？班固作《漢志》，明治曆不可不擇者有三，今求而應者，有若人…
translation_en: …roughly several dozen schools. From the Yellow Emperor (Huangdi 黃帝) down to the end of the Qin, the calendar was reformed six times in all; from the Western Han to the Eastern Han, five times; from the Wei to the end of the Sui, thirteen times; from the Tang to the end of the Later Zhou, sixteen times; from Emperor Taizu of Song (Song Taizu 宋太祖) to the end of the Song, eighteen times; and from the Jin to the Yuan, three times. Can the details of these be set forth? Among them, there were three schools whose precision in calculation and verification later generations could not depart from; can their methods still be traced today? Now, the reform of any single calendar is not a matter of chance coincidence or lucky guesswork. It synthesizes the deliberations of the many, examines and measures diagrams and gnomon shadows, leaving no wisdom unexhausted in thought and no technique overlooked in method—so it ought to remain unchanged forever. Yet even the work of those across the ages who excelled in calendrical science would fall into discrepancy after scarcely a few years; what is the reason for this? Since our Dynasty received the Mandate, the three calendars have harmonized with the Five Regulators, and great unification has been verified in the Seven Governors; the reverent accord of Yao 堯 and the solemn ordering of Shun 舜 did not surpass this. Yet although our calendar bears the name Datong (Great Concordance 大統), its accumulated fractions still follow the figures of the Shoushi (Season-Granting 授時) calendar. As the years grow distant and the numbers accumulate, it gradually deviates from the celestial degrees. Officials of the Directorate of Astronomy have repeatedly submitted proposals wishing to revise and correct it in accordance with the times, yet we do not know whether they truly possess a settled view? Those who observe celestial phenomena do no more than gauge them by the eclipses of the sun and moon. Prior to the Han and Wei, solar eclipses all occurred on the first day of the month (shuo 朔), whereas afterward they sometimes occurred on the last day of the month (hui 晦)—why is this as well? When Ban Gu 班固 composed the Treatises of the History of the Han (Hanzhi 漢志), he made clear that in regulating the calendar there are three types of specialists who must be selected; if we seek them today, are there such men who can answer the call…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
歟諸士冥搜博考必有達天人之際者
願究言之將以轉告于太史
問自古論治者貴識體識其大也甞稽載
籍因時立政代有損益大都不越質文
遲速寛猛動靜之變耳昔周監二代孔
子致美於郁郁之文矣他日乃曰虞夏
之道寡怨於民商周之道不勝其弊胡
軒輊不同若此也伯禽治魯三年而報
政周公曰何遲也魯後世其北面事齊
===
===
矣太公治齊五月而報政周公曰何疾
也孔子顧不與之以為必一變而後至
魯夫速者可與圖功而其俗乃不魯若
遲者可以近古而策其受命於霸將何
適而可歟寛一也黃霸用之潁川而大
治子太叔用之鄭國而多盜嚴一也孔
明用之治蜀而興嚴延年用之東海而
敗何趨舍同類而收效殊科也宓子賤
身不下堂彈琴而理單父巫馬期以星
punctuated:
歟？諸士冥搜博考，必有達天人之際者，願究言之，將以轉告于太史。
問：自古論治者貴識體，識其大也。甞稽載籍，因時立政，代有損益，大都不越質文、遲速、寛猛、動靜之變耳。昔周監二代，孔子致美於郁郁之文矣；他日乃曰：「虞、夏之道，寡怨於民；商、周之道，不勝其弊。」胡軒輊不同若此也？伯禽治魯，三年而報政，周公曰：「何遲也？魯後世其北面事齊矣！」太公治齊，五月而報政，周公曰：「何疾也？」孔子顧不與之，以為必一變而後至魯。夫速者可與圖功，而其俗乃不魯若；遲者可以近古，而策其受命於霸，將何適而可歟？寛一也，黃霸用之潁川而大治，子太叔用之鄭國而多盜；嚴一也，孔明用之治蜀而興，嚴延年用之東海而敗。何趨舍同類而收效殊科也？宓子賤身不下堂，彈琴而理單父；巫馬期以星
translation_en:
… are there such men? You gentlemen have searched deeply and examined broadly, and there must be among you those who comprehend the relationship between Heaven and humanity. I wish for you to speak of this exhaustively, so that I may relay your words to the Grand Scribe (Taishi 太史).

Question: Since antiquity, those who discuss governance have valued recognizing its essential structure—that is, recognizing what is fundamental. When we examine the historical records, we find that in establishing governance in accordance with the times, each era had its additions and reductions, yet for the most part these did not go beyond variations in unadorned substance and cultural refinement, slowness and rapidity, leniency and severity, or activity and quiescence. In the past, the Zhou looked back upon the two preceding dynasties, and Confucius praised its cultural refinement as rich and resplendent. Yet on another occasion he said: "The way of Yu 虞 and Xia 夏 aroused little resentment among the people; the way of Shang 商 and Zhou 周 could not overcome its own defects." Why did his evaluations differ so greatly as this? When Boqin 伯禽 governed Lu 魯, he reported on his administration after three years. The Duke of Zhou (Zhougong 周公) said: "Why so slow? In later generations Lu will surely face north to serve Qi 齊!" When Taigong 太公 governed Qi, he reported on his administration after five months, and the Duke of Zhou said: "Why so fast?" Yet Confucius did not grant Qi primacy, holding that Qi would first have to undergo one transformation before it could reach the level of Lu. Now, the rapid approach is one with which achievements can be planned, yet Qi's customs were not equal to those of Lu; the slow approach can approximate antiquity, yet it was predicted that Lu would take orders from a hegemon. Which course should one follow for it to be right? Leniency is one and the same: when Huang Ba 黃霸 employed it in Yingchuan 潁川, great order prevailed, yet when Zi Taishu 子太叔 employed it in the state of Zheng 鄭, bandits multiplied. Severity is one and the same: when Kongming 孔明 [Zhuge Liang 諸葛亮] employed it in governing Shu 蜀, the state flourished, yet when Yan Yannian 嚴延年 employed it in Donghai 東海, he met with ruin. Why is it that when the approaches chosen are of the same kind, the results achieved are in such different categories? Fuzi Jian 宓子賤 did not descend from his hall, playing his zither and yet bringing order to Shanfu 單父; Wuma Qi 巫馬期 went out by the stars…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
出以星入單父亦理將服勤之績顧不
若優游之驗與易言聖人通其變使民
不倦意其所用以綱紀振作者固自有
道歟二三子學古入官講於當世之務
熟矣其悉心折衷以對
問夏典要荒周官蕃鎭夷官之設其來尚
矣
明興平定百粤諸酋納款因而官之俾世掌
其土比封建之遺焉惟旹
===
二祖開天皇稜大抗夷裔之長重足疊跡以待
徴令繼及之際或獻馬貢方物萬里赴
闕請
命最謹嗣後熈恬世際詳近略遠諸酋稍稍越
法馴至于今威令漸弛驕蹇旹肆徴調
愆期什伍虛冒侵疆逋賦嫡孽稱兵西
南之間幾成尾大說者謂繳勘授官始
于天順之
詔輸粟給劄起于成化之中然歟否歟又謂二
punctuated:
出，以星入，單父亦理，將服勤之績顧不若優游之驗與？《易》言「聖人通其變，使民不倦」，意其所用以綱紀振作者，固自有道歟？二三子學古入官，講於當世之務熟矣，其悉心折衷以對。

問：夏典要、荒，《周官》蕃、鎭，夷官之設，其來尚矣。明興，平定百粤，諸酋納款，因而官之，俾世掌其土，比封建之遺焉。惟旹二祖開天，皇稜大抗，夷裔之長重足疊跡以待徴令；繼及之際，或獻馬貢方物，萬里赴闕請命最謹。嗣後熈恬世際，詳近略遠，諸酋稍稍越法。馴至于今，威令漸弛，驕蹇旹肆：徴調愆期，什伍虛冒，侵疆逋賦，嫡孽稱兵，西南之間，幾成尾大。說者謂繳勘授官始于天順之詔，輸粟給劄起于成化之中，然歟否歟？又謂二
translation_en:
… went out under the stars and returned under the stars, and Shanfu was likewise well governed—could it be that the achievements of diligent toil are actually inferior to the efficacy of leisurely ease? The Book of Changes (Yi) states: "The sages carried through the changes so that the people would not grow weary." Could it be that what they used to establish order and rouse action inherently had its own proper way? You gentlemen have studied antiquity in preparation for entering office and have thoroughly discussed the affairs of the present age; devote your whole minds to weighing these matters and reply.

Question: From the "Zone of Restraint" and "Wild Zone" in the canons of Xia to the "Buffer" and "Guard" domains in the Offices of Zhou (Zhouguan), the establishment of offices for non-Chinese peoples goes back to remote antiquity. When the Ming arose and pacified the Hundred Yue, the various chieftains offered submission; consequently, the court granted them official titles and allowed them to govern their lands hereditarily, comparable to a vestige of the feudal enfeoffment system. At the time when the Two Ancestors founded the empire, imperial majesty was greatly exalted, and the leaders of the distant borderlands stood in awe, waiting on tiptoe for summonses and commands. Upon occasions of hereditary succession, they would present horses and offer local tribute, traveling ten thousand li to the palace gates to petition for their patents of investiture with the utmost reverence. Thereafter, during an era of peace and tranquility, the court paid close attention to what was near while neglecting what was far, and the various chieftains gradually overstepped the law. Gradually down to the present day, authority and ordinances have grown lax, and arrogance and unruliness are frequently indulged: troop requisitions miss their deadlines, military rosters are falsified, boundaries are encroached upon and taxes evaded, and legitimate heirs and concubines' sons take up arms against one another, so that in the southwest the tail has almost grown too big to wag. Commentators claim that returning verification certificates to receive official appointment began with an edict of the Tianshun reign (1457–1464), and that contributing grain to be granted a commission originated during the Chenghua period (1465–1487)—is this so or not? Others claim that in the Two…

title: 萬曆四年廣西鄉試錄
text:
廣威力全藉土兵一切釁瑕向示包荒
不盡漢法將何以善其後歟玆欲振舉
頹綱收綜長策不納侮不黷兵内寧而
無外憂其要安在諸生比境連壤耳目
睹記最眞不可謂細故也願詳言制馭
之略
punctuated: 廣威力全藉土兵，一切釁瑕，向示包荒，不盡漢法，將何以善其後歟？玆欲振舉頹綱，收綜長策，不納侮，不黷兵，内寧而無外憂，其要安在？諸生比境連壤，耳目睹記最眞，不可謂細故也，願詳言制馭之略。
translation_en: … the military might of the Two Guangs (Guangdong and Guangxi) relies entirely on native troops (tubing), so for all their faults and infractions, we have heretofore shown magnanimous tolerance and not subjected them fully to Chinese law—how, then, shall we manage the consequences in the future? Now, if we wish to restore the slackened order and gather together a long-term strategy, neither inviting insult nor engaging in wanton warfare, so that there is tranquility within and no worry from without, wherein lies the essential key? You students live in neighboring territories and adjoining lands; what you have seen and heard with your own eyes and ears is most authentic, and this cannot be called a trivial matter. I hope you will speak in detail of the general strategy for controlling and managing them.
